# Forest Biomass Package

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Description: A package developed to convert field data to forest biomass

Principal Author: Thomson Harris - thomsonharris@gmail.com


# Release State:

This package is under current development and changes are expected rapidly.  



# Current Uses:

## Tree Biomass 

Supported:
- Woody stem
- Foliage
- Bark
- Branches 

Undeveloped:
- Roots
